name: 论文发现 Step checkpoint、取消与恢复

implemented: checksum-protected migration v3 for Step side-effect policies and per-Attempt effect state
durable five-Step paper-discovery path using Artifact checkpoints
call intent persistence before arXiv or Provider invocation
committed checkpoint reuse without repeated search or Provider calls
safe replay of an interrupted uncommitted arXiv read after lease expiry
waiting_for_user gate for Provider request_started without a committed response
explicit retry-or-fail recovery decision with automatic replay disabled
queued and in-flight cooperative cancellation with zero subsequent external calls
deferred: Budget limit, reservation, actual usage, and hard-stop ledger
structured ErrorRecord and user-facing diagnostic CLI status
network, real Provider, paid service, and live acceptance

workflow.checkpoint_transport: content-addressed JSON Artifacts with authoritative SQLite registrations

acceptance_results.criterion: five committed Steps survive Repository reconstruction and form one atomic partial Delivery
interrupted arXiv read without a committed response is safely replayed after lease expiry
unknown Provider outcome enters waiting_for_user and performs zero automatic replay
explicit retry decision permits exactly one new Provider attempt while preserving the unknown Attempt
explicit fail decision closes the Run without another Provider call
queued or in-flight cancellation starts no subsequent external Step
Task idempotency freezes workflow, Prompt, code revision, Provider/model, and parameters

focused_tests.command: uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_sqlite_runtime.py tests/test_worker_leases.py tests/test_durable_paper_discovery.py -q

compileall.command: uv run --frozen python -m compileall -q src tests scripts

verification.corrective_iteration: A lineage-manifest scope error caused the publish Step to fail in an intermediate focused run; it was corrected and the complete focused and full suites were rerun successfully.

execution_boundary.fixtures: deterministic transports, temporary SQLite, and local filesystem
execution_boundary.process_exit_simulation: BaseException escapes the Worker to preserve an in-flight lease
execution_boundary.claim: W3.3 proves bounded checkpoint and replay-safety semantics with fixtures; it does not prove real process-kill recovery or live paper-discovery quality.
